newsitem.title: JAPAN: Terumo shares down on newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Terumo shares down on newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in Terumo Corp slipped on Tuesday morning, hurt by newspaper reports about its intravenous food supplements, traders said.
At 0058 GMT, Terumo was down 40 yen at 2,120. Volume was 306,000 shares.
Shares of Tanabe Seiyaku Co Ltd, which also makes the products, retreated on the newspaper reports, but they later recovered to 1,040 yen by midday, up 20 yen.

Japanese makers of intravenous food supplements said on Tuesday that the products were safe when administered properly, adding that they would comply with an order to supply full instructions on their use to doctors.

Japan's Ministry of Health and Welfare issued an emergency order to the companies on Monday to provide full safety instructions on the use of the supplements which it said in a report were suspected of causing death in 41 cases since 1990.
